text: ……いや　おまえの　ことじゃねえよ　おまえの　たたかい　かたが　かっこいいんだよ！

structure.jp: おまえの　ことじゃねえよ
おまえの　たたかい　かたが

patterns.name: 〜ではない
patterns.explanation: じゃねえ is the rough, slurred male way of saying ではない, 'is not'. おまえの　ことじゃねえ = 'it's not about you'

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた after the stem of a verb means 'the way of doing' it. たたかい　かた = 'the way you battle'

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ, used to set the listener straight with an explanation. かっこいいんだ = 'it's that (it) is cool'
